items.statement: Among adults having colorectal resection, full compliance with all applicable bundle elements is associated with lower 30-day surgical site infection after adjustment for emergency status, contamination, stoma formation, diabetes, obesity and operation length (adjusted odds ratio 0.7 or lower).
items.rationale: A multicentre study found an association of this size (c1); the local question is whether it holds with complete post-discharge surveillance and emergency cases included.
items.risks: Residual confounding; about 50 infections a year limits precision.

items.statement: Full compliance is below 25 percent in emergency resections because normothermia and glucose are not recorded.
Oral antibiotic bowel preparation is the element most strongly associated with lower infection in elective cases.
items.rationale: Reported elsewhere, but elements are correlated.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 selected as the primary association.
